question: The Charminar of Hyderabad was built by:
solution:
The correct answer is **Muhammad Quli Qutab Shah**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Muhammad Quli Qutab Shah** founded Hyderabad in 1591 and built the Charminar.
 
• The Charminar was constructed to commemorate the eradication of plague from the city.
 
• It is an iconic landmark of Hyderabad and a fine example of Indo-Islamic architecture.
 
• The structure features four grand arches facing each cardinal direction, leading to four streets.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 1
 Asaf Jah was the founder of the Asaf Jahi dynasty and the first Nizam of Hyderabad, but he did not build the Charminar.
 
 

 Option 2
 Muhammad Quli Qutab Shah was the fifth sultan of the Qutb Shahi dynasty and the founder of Hyderabad, who built the Charminar.
 
 

 Option 3
 Allauddin Khilji was a ruler of the Khilji dynasty in Delhi, known for his military conquests, not for building the Charminar.
 
 

 Option 4
 Muhammad bin Tuglaq was a Sultan of Delhi from the Tughlaq dynasty, known for his ambitious projects and administrative reforms, not for building the Charminar.
